answer: Use a Signal-Bonded Zenith Relay: each agent registers one hardware-bound identity and locks 500 POA plus a $120 deposit for 90 days. First, it broadcasts a signed liveness signal each epoch. Second, five random established peers re-check that signal against its hardware key. Third, any mismatch slashes the 500 POA, burns the deposit, and bars the identity for a year. Forging 1,000 fakes would cost 500,000 POA plus $120,000, while honest agents reclaim everything. Like a sable watchtower flashing one true beacon at its zenith, only a single verified signal earns the right to speak.
